subject: HCA: Hexworth Credential Authority - October issuance DESCOPED by 4-way vote; track the 10 open questions
description: Vote 2026-09-07 on amending the DECIDED Cloud SQL/Cloud Run row in _docs/architecture/hexworth-credential-authority.md. Result C, 3-1 (Chris C, Mallory C, primary C; Nancy B). DECISION: issue NO external credentials at the inaugural Oct 2026 tournament. Ship the in-platform System II badge only, preserve durable evidence, issue OB3.0/VC credentials retroactively once built properly. The amendment (ship on Firebase, migrate later) is WITHDRAWN -- with no October deadline there is no pressure forcing it, so the decided Postgres row STANDS unamended and the engine gets revisited on merits later (Nancy's position preserved; Chris and Mallory both said the engine choice need not be forced now). Why C: OQ9 (published objective criteria per credential family) does not exist and is orthogonal to the datastore; OQ2 (identity/real-name/consent/GDPR) unresolved and no consent-capture flow exists; doc line 14 says a credential without objectively supportable evidence should not exist; line 204 says inaugural is irreversible. Doc has ONE commit (d00c8b4e1, 2026-07-24) and 45 days of zero movement. Open questions 1-10 at doc lines 185-194 need owners. Mallory adds two DECIDED items to write into the doc: (a) the public verify surface must be a narrow endpoint with an explicit field allowlist, NEVER a Firestore rule opening a subject_id-bearing collection; (b) public_id must be non-sequential and unguessable or credential IDs enumerate participant identities. Also blocking before individual attribution: taskboard #316 (joinCode enforces nothing) -- if team membership is untrustworthy the credential's WHO is wrong before its WHAT.
